hypothesis: A wavelength-scaled complex wave-packet bank can expose multiple local propagation branches, while local Gram features preserve the relative phase between branches after quotienting one common global phase.

matched_continuation.initialization: copy the existing 5-channel checkpoint and zero-initialize all new input weights

primary_gate.metric: physical-system-paired relative reduction in contrast RelL2, after averaging each physical system over three seeds
primary_gate.safety_condition: IID full-context RelL2 must not degrade by more than 2%

claim_guard: The packet bank is a representation POC, not a path-semantic decomposition. A failed 15% gate forbids promotion to the paper's main method even when individual seeds are positive.
